resources.string: Optional GIF search, local stickers and WhatsApp sharing
Your offline emoji keyboard is always available. Enable media to add GIF and sticker buttons to its emoji panel.
No account or key entry is needed. This private build can include a GIPHY key, with keyless web search as a fallback. Conversation text is never sent. Media stays idle while you type.
This build includes a GIPHY key. No setup needed.
No key bundled. Turn this option off to use keyless web search.
Use GIPHY API with web fallback
GIPHY · No key needed. Shows the website’s initial results; refine your search for more.

You can turn off API access and use GIPHY’s public website without any key. Web search may need an app update if the website changes. Unknown ratings are excluded; mature results need their own toggle.
Testing search, preview and a full download on this connection…
Search reachable, but no results. Media delivery is unverified.
Search, preview and a full media download succeeded on this connection.
Transfer cache cleared. Your local library is kept.
Clear transfers only after receiving apps finish reading them. Transfers older than 24 hours are removed on the next download. The cache and local library each have a 64 MB limit.
Tap a result to preview. Nothing is sent until you choose Insert or Share.
Online stickers are animated GIF reactions. Use local images to create a native WhatsApp sticker pack.
No results. Try another search or import an image into Local.
The conversation could not accept this media. Open it again and choose Share.
Conversation changed. Open media again to insert or share.
This app does not advertise support for this format. Use Share to choose a recipient.
Exports 3–30 local static images as a WhatsApp sticker pack. GIFs and animated WebP are excluded.
